class.name: IfcContextDependentUnit
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-41:1992 : A context dependent unit is a unit which is not related to the SI system. NOTE The number of parts in an assembly is a physical quantity measured in units that may be called "parts" but which cannot be related to an SI unit. NOTE Corresponding ISO 10303 name: context_dependent_unit, please refer to ISO/IS 10303-41 for the final definition of the formal standa

members.member: The word, or group of words, by which the context dependent unit is referred to.
